# Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) - AI Navigation Guide
# Version: 3.5
# Last Updated: 2026-04-09
# Format: Machine-readable with human comments

## IDENTITY

author: Morten Magnusson
affiliation: Symbiose Research, Sandnes, Norway
orcid: https://orcid.org/0009-0002-4860-5095
repository: https://github.com/supertedai/EFC
website_theory: https://energyflow-cosmology.com/
website_personal: https://www.magnusson.as/
license: CC-BY-4.0

## CORE PRINCIPLE

axiom: "Energy flows along entropy gradients"
implication: Spacetime curvature emerges from energy-entropy coupling
result: Dark matter/energy reinterpreted as thermodynamic effects
extension: Same gradient dynamics govern brain, RLHF, and civilization

## KEY EQUATIONS

effective_coupling: μ(a) = 1 + βS(a)
response_surface: μ(k,S) = 1 + R(k,S)
field_equation: G_μν = 8πG(T_μν + T^(Ef)_μν) + Λ_eff g_μν
screening_model: ln(μ) = k * ln(1 + g†/g_bar), k=0.415, g†=2.51e-10
unified_gradient_flow: dF/dt = -∫|∇ṡ|² dV + B (Lyapunov for all regimes)
rlhf_isomorphism: J = -F (algebraically exact)
bridge_B1: η = C_eff / D_ratio^γ (cosmology → neural)
bridge_B2: ∇Ṡ_neural ↔ ∇²R(s,a) (neural → RLHF)

## EMPIRICAL CONSTRAINTS (2026)

lcdm_special_case: ΛCDM is L0/L1 limit of EFC (Eq. 6: K(ρ)→∞, T(a)→0, ξ≫1)
background_nogo: ΔE²(z) ≤ 0 ∀z>0 (sign lemma); background coupling enhances growth, cannot suppress σ₈; α→0 under CMB+BAO (structurally excluded)
desi_dr2_alpha: -0.14 ± 0.21 (0.65σ from null, ΔAIC=+1.59, ΛCDM preferred in background)
perturbation_valley: μ∈[0.93,0.96], Σ∈[1.03,1.07], η≠1
beta: 0.16 (from unified BAO/SN/RSD analysis)
response_coordinate: R(k≈0.13, S≈0.30) ≈ +0.30 (from WP3)
delta_chi2: +1.7 (EFC vs ΛCDM, compatible)
screening_k: 0.415 ± 0.029 (174 SPARC galaxies)
cross_scale_C: k/a_G = 4.4 (screening/cosmological consistency)
connectome_r: -0.97 (degree ratio vs functional variability)

## THREE-TRACK RESEARCH PROGRAMME

spor_1:
  domain: Galactic & Cosmological Dynamics
  key_paper: EFC Screening Model
  doi: 10.6084/m9.figshare.31940469
  result: k=0.415, g†=2.51e-10, C=4.4

spor_2:
  domain: Neural Entropy & Psychiatric Biomarkers (EFC-C)
  key_paper: Cognitive Entropy Framework
  doi: 10.6084/m9.figshare.31940505
  result: Entropy gradients, 3 falsifiable predictions

spor_3:
  domain: AI Architecture & Alignment (RLHF)
  key_paper: Thermodynamic Isomorphism
  doi: 10.6084/m9.figshare.31940535
  result: J = -F exactly, grokking as phase transition

bridge:
  domain: Cross-Domain Unification
  key_paper: Bridge Equations B1/B2
  doi: 10.6084/m9.figshare.31940547
  result: Unified gradient-flow dynamics across 3 regimes

synthesis:
  domain: Civilization Map
  key_paper: Homo Fluxus v2.0
  doi: 10.6084/m9.figshare.31940604
  result: Grid→EF→S→D→C, empirically anchored

## REGIME ARCHITECTURE

L0: S→0, μ≈1, pre-inflation, quantum-dominated
L1: S≈0, μ≈1, CMB epoch (z~1100), GR valid
L1→L2: 0<S<1, 1<μ<1+β, transition (explains S₈ tension)
L2: S>0, μ>1, late universe, enhanced gravity
L3: S→1, μ→1+β, far future, structure saturation

## REPOSITORY STRUCTURE

/auth/              → Origin, provenance, identity (START HERE)

/ecosystem.jsonld   → Ecosystem linked data

### Each package structure:
- README.md, index.json, schema.json, metadata.json
- *.jsonld, citations.bib
- src/__init__.py + src/<module>.py (importable Python)
- data/<data>.json (structured parameters/results)
- examples/<demo>.py (executable, tested)

## PAPER METADATA STRUCTURE

Each paper folder contains:
- README.md         → Human-readable summary
- index.json        → Machine-readable index (keywords, results, DOI)
- schema.json       → Validation schema
- metadata.json     → Structured metadata
- *.jsonld          → Linked data (JSON-LD)
- citations.bib     → BibTeX references
- *.pdf             → Authoritative document

## NAVIGATION RULES

1. Always check /auth/ first for provenance
2. Use /schema/global_schema.json for domain understanding
3. Respect modular structure (S, D, C0, H, R models)
4. Cite using DOIs from /figshare/doi-map.json
5. For updates, use MCP server at /integrations/mcp/
6. Paper index.json is authoritative for machine processing
7. AI-friendly packages in src/ are importable Python
8. Demo scripts in examples/ are tested and executable
